name: Sárospatak (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Sárospatak: a crowned white shield with a green tree, a bunch of grapes and a fleur-de-lis.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
